name: LES-S Launch Escape Tower
frame: Godot Y-up, metres; origin per CONVENTIONS.md; direction = outward unit normal of the mating face

ax_cmd_14_launch_escape_tower.label: LES-S Launch Escape Tower
ax_cmd_14_launch_escape_tower.notes: Launch abort system for the Kestrel: solid Orion-style faceted tower (8 facets) with a nozzle collar of 4 canted abort nozzles in bevelled pockets, 8 attitude-control ports, recessed panel line, faceted nose; faceted boost protective cover enclosing the capsule (35 mm clearance) with an orange stripe. No lattice.

extra.host: AX-cmd-02 (mates its node_top; the boost cover encloses the capsule down to its shield shoulder)

summary: Solid Orion-style tractor abort tower for Kestrel-class capsules: faceted tower, 4 canted abort nozzles, boost protective cover
